steps: Take the paneer, onion and capsicum out of the fridge; they have soaked up the curd, ginger, garlic, spice powders, kasuri methi and salt.
Thread the paneer, onion and capsicum pieces in turns onto small skewers.
Heat a flat pan or tawa on medium and spread the rest of the oil over it.
Lay the skewers on the hot pan and cook on medium heat.
Turn them every minute or two until golden on all sides, about 8 to 10 minutes in all.
For a smoky edge, hold each skewer over an open gas flame for a few seconds, until lightly charred.
Squeeze the lemon over the tikka, sprinkle the chaat masala and serve hot.
note: Yogurt ranged from 30 to 65 g a serving; 35 g of thick yogurt coats the pieces well, as two of the three sources use. Marinating for 2 hours gives more flavour, and one source warns that overnight can make the paneer break.
